body.name: Fully observed completion obstruction
body.construction: When \(U=\varnothing\), for an exact support \(S\), record two deterministic completions \(h,h'\) of all parent rows not reached by \(S\), sharing every reached row and every restriction at \(W\), such that \(\mathbf 1\{Y_x(h)=y\}\ne\mathbf 1\{Y_x(h')=y\}\).
